protocol.prefill: native phase timings; per-request metric deltas for dense engines
protocol.decode: client SSE (output tokens - 1) / first-to-last nonempty content interval
protocol.promotion_rule: Larger context and all quality/headroom checks passed. The user accepted GLM64K and StrataDeepSeek128K screen tradeoffs; their confirmations use the accepted-screen reference. Other profiles require median prefill/decode >= fresh control and TTFT <= control. A screen within 3% may receive confirmation; this is not a relaxed final speed rule.
protocol.long_context: Separately measured retrieval near 90% of allocation; not compared as equal work with the short fixture.
protocol.cache: expert seed frozen per engine; prefix reuse checked; OS page cache not flushed; order not randomized
